matrix: Exactly the 12 conditions, attack parameters, seed42 and batch96 training recipe in the hash-pinned M3 parent lock
scope: Single development seed42, IID CIFAR10/ResNet18. A matched descriptive research comparison; no new RTC version, statistical superiority or final release acceptance.
checks: Per condition: report mean/final/tail10 ACC, mean/peak/tail10/final ASR, M3-MK differences, malicious/benign weights, geometry and runtime. Flag ACC drops >0.2pp, any targeted ASR increase, and M3 benign cap rate >1%. These are prospective comparison annotations with M3 results already known, not retrospective M3 acceptance gates.
quality: Every planned cell completed/exit0/round60; 61 unique rounds and 600 unique client rows; all runner and recomputed attack execution gates; exact source archive, configuration and same original environment; same TrialPlan/data/initial model/identities/client-fit streams. Replay R1/R2 and M3 confirmed-memory/cumulative/budgets; reconstruct ACC/label ASR; validate triggered ASR and MK five weights of 0.2.
stop_rule: No extra seeds, attack tuning, automatic retries or baseline replacement. Incomplete/failed/orphan results stop before any remaining cells start. Completed validated cells may be skipped; no mid-round checkpoint resume.
limitations: M3 outcome data were examined before this comparison protocol; seed42 is development evidence, not an independent holdout.
Known M3 Min-Sum/all-reverse benign-cap failures and targeted ASR spikes remain even if MK is worse.
Single-seed superiority does not establish multi-seed or non-IID generalization; final ablations and validation remain outstanding.
Random-v2 scale10 remains exploratory without a FedAvg strength screen.
Random participation can exceed f3 in a round; this is an empirical pressure comparison, not a Krum theoretical guarantee.
MK R1/R2 observers do not intervene. Observer flags are not MK false positives; discarded clients are not automatically malicious detections.
Triggered ASR has no exported per-image predictions; only denominator, validity and count consistency are independently checkable.
